title: A Birthday Visitor
setting: A garden with a small table behind a house.

characters.name: Dan
characters.look: Dan, a young man with short brown hair and a blue shirt

characters.name: Aiko
characters.look: Aiko, a young woman with long black hair and a yellow dress

sentences.en: Aiko comes to Dan's house for his birthday.
sentences.zh: 爱子来丹家给他过生日。
sentences.scene_prompt: Aiko, a young woman with long black hair and a yellow dress arrives at the door with a gift, Dan, a young man with short brown hair and a blue shirt welcoming her.

sentences.en: They wait for the cake at a garden table.
sentences.zh: 他们坐在花园的桌边等蛋糕。
sentences.scene_prompt: Dan, a young man with short brown hair and a blue shirt and Aiko, a young woman with long black hair and a yellow dress sit at a small garden table with empty plates, waiting.

sentences.en: Aiko puts butter on warm bread for Dan.
sentences.zh: 爱子给丹在热面包上抹黄油。
sentences.scene_prompt: Aiko, a young woman with long black hair and a yellow dress spreads butter on a slice of bread for Dan, a young man with short brown hair and a blue shirt at the garden table.

sentences.en: Just then, Finn the pig comes near them.
sentences.zh: 就在这时，小猪芬恩走到他们身边。
sentences.scene_prompt: Finn, a small pink pig trots up close to the garden table where Dan, a young man with short brown hair and a blue shirt and Aiko, a young woman with long black hair and a yellow dress sit.

sentences.en: The hungry animal finds a carrot under the table.
sentences.zh: 这只饿坏了的动物在桌子底下找到一根胡萝卜。
sentences.scene_prompt: Finn, a small pink pig sniffs an orange carrot on the grass under the garden table.

sentences.en: It eats all of the carrot very fast.
sentences.zh: 它飞快地把整根胡萝卜都吃光了。
sentences.scene_prompt: Finn, a small pink pig quickly munches the whole carrot, only the green top left.

sentences.en: Then it pulls the bread off Dan's plate.
sentences.zh: 接着它把丹盘子里的面包拽走了。
sentences.scene_prompt: Finn, a small pink pig pulls a buttered slice of bread off the plate of Dan, a young man with short brown hair and a blue shirt, who looks surprised.

sentences.en: Later, Dan closes the gate so it stays out.
sentences.zh: 后来，丹关上了大门，让它待在外面。
sentences.scene_prompt: Dan, a young man with short brown hair and a blue shirt closes the garden gate while Finn, a small pink pig stands outside it, Aiko, a young woman with long black hair and a yellow dress laughing.
